description: Find alternative approaches: when stuck on a programming problem, reveals 3rd/4th/5th options you haven't considered, with cost of each. Use when you think there's only 1-2 ways to do something. Put your PROBLEM in the 'problem' parameter.

constraints.description: Technical constraints: language, framework, performance requirements, team size

files.description: File paths to read as code context. Supports line ranges: 'src/foo.ts:100-200'. Model sees ACTUAL CODE.

model.description: Model to use - gpt-6-astra (default, flagship), gpt-5.6-sol (previous flagship), gpt-5.6-terra (balanced), gpt-5.6-luna (fast/cheap)

problem.description: The engineering problem or design tradeoff to brainstorm about (REQUIRED)

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort level - must be one of: none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max (gpt-6-astra runs none as low)

name: openai_brainstorm
